title: US announces 25% tariffs on all imported autos and auto parts
content: A 25% tariff on imported vehicles and parts pressured automakers and broad risk appetite ahead of the April reciprocal-tariff deadline.

title: US core PCE comes in hotter than expected; consumer sentiment slumps, S&P 500 falls ~2%
content: Core PCE inflation surprised to the upside and consumer sentiment dropped, sending equities down about 2% as stagflation worries grew.

title: Liberation Day: US unveils sweeping reciprocal tariffs on nearly all trading partners
content: The US announced broad reciprocal tariffs after the close, far harsher than expected, a level-3 alert for global trade and systemic equity risk.

title: S&P 500 plunges 4.8%, worst single day since 2020 as tariff shock hits
content: US equities suffered their worst day since the 2020 pandemic crash as investors priced in the reciprocal-tariff regime.

title: China retaliates with 34% tariffs on all US goods; S&P 500 drops another ~6%
content: Beijing matched with across-the-board 34% tariffs, escalating to a full trade war. Global equities fell sharply for a second day.

title: Taiwan's TAIEX plunges nearly 10% at the open — largest single-day drop on record; TSMC limit-down
content: Reopening after a holiday, the Taiwan Stock Exchange opened with a record intraday plunge of almost 10%, with TSMC and exporters limit-down on direct US-tariff exposure.

title: US announces 90-day pause on most reciprocal tariffs; S&P 500 surges ~9.5% in historic rally
content: A 90-day pause (China excepted) sparked one of the largest single-day equity rallies on record as recession tail-risk was repriced lower.

title: China raises tariffs on US goods to 125%; markets give back part of the rebound
content: Beijing escalated tariffs to 125% even as the US paused others, and equities surrendered a chunk of the prior day's historic gains.

title: US exempts smartphones, computers and semiconductors from reciprocal tariffs
content: An exemption for key electronics and chips relieved the technology supply chain, a clear positive for semiconductors and AI hardware names.

title: Nvidia warns of $5.5bn charge as US restricts H20 AI-chip exports to China; chips sell off
content: New US export curbs on Nvidia's China-bound H20 accelerators triggered a multi-billion-dollar charge and dragged the broader semiconductor complex lower.

title: TSMC posts record Q1 profit on AI demand and keeps full-year guidance despite tariff noise
content: TSMC reported a record first-quarter profit driven by AI accelerator demand and maintained its growth outlook, reassuring investors. A positive surprise.

title: Equities fall ~2.4% as the President escalates attacks on the Fed Chair, raising independence fears
content: Public pressure on the Fed Chair to cut rates and threats to his position rattled markets, with the S&P 500 down about 2.4% on central-bank-independence concerns.

title: Markets rally as the administration softens tone on China tariffs and backs off Fed-firing threat
content: Conciliatory signals on both China tariffs and Fed independence drove a sharp relief rally, with risk assets recovering much of the week's losses.
